business_summary: The Kansai Electric Power Company, Incorporated engages in electricity, heat supply, telecommunication, and gas supply in Japan. It operates through four segments: Energy Business; Power Transmission and Distribution Business; Information and Communication Business; and Lifestyle and Business Solution Business. The company generates power from thermal, hydropower, wind, biomass, and nuclear power generation plants. It also involved in the power transmission and distribution business; the provision of information and communication services for homes and businesses under the eo Hikari brand; mobile business under the mineo business; corporate solution business; and real estate leasing, sales, and management activities; and leisure, leasing, call center management, medical and health care, and home security businesses. In addition, the company engages in the design, construction, operation, maintenance, and management of power generation, power distribution, electrical, and information communication facilities, and information and communication equipment; manufacture and sale of electrical wiring hardware, insulators, bushings, steel pipe columns, concrete poles, and other electrical distribution equipment and materials; housing equipment sales; construction contracting; renovation work; and passenger/freight transportation. Further, it involved in the survey and research on safety technology for nuclear power generation; survey, design, and construction supervision related to civil engineering, etc.; and provision of survey, analysis, consulting, and construction services related to the environment, civil engineering, and architecture, as well as public relations and engineering services. The Kansai Electric Power Company, Incorporated was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Kansai Electric Power Company, Incorporated는 일본에서 전기, 열 공급, 통신 및 가스 공급에 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 네 가지 부문을 통해 운영됩니다: 에너지 사업; 송배전사업; 정보통신사업; 라이프스타일 및 비즈니스 솔루션 사업. 이 회사는 화력, 수력, 풍력, 바이오매스, 원자력 발전소에서 전력을 생산합니다. 또한 송전 및 배전 사업에도 참여했습니다. eo Hikari 브랜드로 가정과 기업을 위한 정보 통신 서비스 제공; 미네오사업부의 모바일 사업; 기업 솔루션 사업; 부동산 임대, 판매, 관리 활동; 레저, 임대, 콜센터 관리, 의료 및 건강 관리, 주택 보안 사업. 또한 회사는 발전, 배전, 전기 및 정보통신 시설과 정보통신 장비의 설계, 건설, 운영, 유지 및 관리 업무를 영위합니다. 전기 배선 철물, 절연체, 부싱, 강관 기둥, 콘크리트 기둥, 기타 전기 제품의 제조 및 판매
